changeSet.sql: UPDATE acc_gl_financial_activity_account f SET gl_account_id=target.id FROM acc_gl_account target, acc_gl_account old WHERE f.financial_activity_type=102 AND f.gl_account_id=old.id AND old.gl_code='111001' AND target.gl_code='1110010199' AND target.classification_enum=1 AND target.account_usage=1 AND target.disabled=FALSE;
